[[Horm Frostrider]] is a leader of the Shiverpeak [[centaur]]s, and a driving force behind an anti-[[Human]] alliance with the Maguuma centaurs.  Stopping his negotiations with the Maguuma Centaur leader [[Ramtha Brokenhoof]] is the bonus objective in [[The Wilds]] [[mission]].
